_note: Reproducible, name-based spec of the asthma home-monitoring PlanDefinition. Concept references are by concept_name (resolve to GUIDs at build time). POST the GUID-resolved form to /api/v1/plandefinitions (see build script in session scratchpad). This file documents intent; it is not consumed by an existing loader.
title: Asthma home monitoring
name: asthma-home-monitoring
description: Home monitoring plan for asthma: a daily symptom and peak-flow diary, plus optional weekly home spirometry.
purpose: Remote monitoring of asthma control and early detection of deterioration between clinic visits.
usage: Daily self-report by the patient at home; weekly FEV1 if a home spirometer is available. Per-patient alerting thresholds (e.g. % personal-best PEF) are configured downstream in request.pdhc, not in this template.

activities.title: Daily asthma diary
activities.description: Daily self-reported symptoms and peak expiratory flow.

activities.title: Weekly home spirometry
activities.description: Weekly home FEV1 where a home spirometer is available.
